The '''Thimram family''' was a wealthy noble family from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="BC">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050414planet1|series=Byss and the Deep Core|text=Part 1: Byss}}</ref> Prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hella Thimram]] was the hands-on CEO of [[ChandrilTech]], having taken over from her [[Hella Thimram's grandfather|grandfather]]. CEO Thimram's leadership was a source of pride across Chandrila. Hella's eldest son, [[Savuud Thimram|Savuud]], was appointed as the [[Senator/Legends|Imperial Senator]] of [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], largely on the reputation of his mother.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
